svg.title: Pi TimeLens in a real Pi terminal session
svg.desc: A selected successful-turn transcript crop from Pi 0.85.1 at 120 columns. Two read tools run in parallel. TimeLens shows assistant latency, one consolidated batch record without empty token placeholders, and the final request total.
svg.metadata: Selected from a real Pi 0.85.1 TUI session at 120 columns on 2026-09-07. Successful-turn transcript text, wrapping, ordering, and theme colors are preserved; startup, transient working/status UI, update notice, footer, and filesystem path are omitted.

g.text: Pi TimeLens · faithful Pi 0.85.1 transcript · 120 columns
Use the read tool to read auth.ts and config.ts in one parallel tool batch, then reply with exactly: Verified both
